image_description: An interior view of a lumber processing facility (sawmill). The foreground is dominated by large stacks of rough-sawn timber planks resting on wooden supports. In the mid-ground, two human figures are visible working among the logs; one on the right wears dark clothing and appears to be handling wood, while another is further back on the left. The background reveals the industrial structure with heavy wooden beams, metal trusses, and machinery components typical of a sawmill environment.
